title: Folinic acid therapy in patients with Kearns-Sayre syndrome (KSS) and cerebral folate deficiency - mitoFolat
official: Folinic acid therapy in patients with Kearns-Sayre syndrome (KSS) and cerebral folate deficiency - mitoFolat
summary: Main objective: To assess the efficacy of folinic acid administration in comparison to no treatment to the clinical outcome with regard to KSS
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Children and adolescents with KSS 6 to17 years of age
2. Disease onset at < 12 years of age
3. 5MTHF concentration < 20 nmol/L in CSF at screening. Result not older than 6 months
4. Diagnosed with a symptom complex consisting of progressive external ophthalmoplegia, ptosis, and pigmentary retinopathy, plus additionally one of: cardiac conduction defects, cerebellar syndrome or elevated CSF protein (>100mg/dl)
5. Identification of a single large-scale mtDNA deletion and/or duplication or mtDNA m.3243A>G mutation (rs199474667) in at least 2 different cell types (blood cells, urine cells)
6. Written informed consent of the legally designated representatives as of the minor who is capable to comprehend the nature, significance and implications of the clinical trial and to form a rational intention in the light of these facts
7. Willingness to use contraception to avoid pregnancy during trial
Exclusion criteria:
1. Current and previous folic and folinic acid therapy (within the last 6 months before begin of the trial)
2. Pregnancy and/or breastfeeding.
3. Subjects dependent on sponsor, investigator or trial sites
4. Persons deprived of liberty or placed in an institution by judicial or administrative order
5. Consumption of synthetic folic or folinic acid (within the last 6 months before begin of the trial)
6. Acute infections (e.g. pneumonia, sepsis)
7. Contraindications for MRI/MRS (e.g. cochlear implant, pacemaker, etc.)
8. Pernicious anemia
9. Current medication with one or more of the following: phenobarbital, phenytoin, primidone, succinimides
10. Simultaneous participation in other interventional trials which could interfere with this trial; simultaneous participation in registry and diagnostic trials is allowed
11. Hypersensitivity to the active substance of the IMP or any other ingredient
12. Participation in any other interventional clinical trial within the last 30 days or 5 half-lifes of the investigational product of the other clinical trial, whichever is loinger, before the start of this trial
